# NillTech Solutions

> Managed technology delivery company based in Nairobi, Kenya. We Build the Team. You Own the Outcome.

NillTech Solutions is not a freelancer marketplace and not an agency. It is a managed delivery
partner: one accountable team, not a pool of contractors. Primary markets: Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania,
Rwanda, with secondary reach into the US, UK and Canada.

## Offers

- [AI-Powered Software Development](https://nilltechsolutions.com/services): websites, custom
  software, e-commerce and business systems for SMEs, schools, churches, e-commerce operators and
  organisations.
- [AI Solutions for SMEs](https://nilltechsolutions.com/ai-solutions): automation, chatbots and AI
  integrations for SME owners and ops leads.
- [AI Training and Data Annotation](https://nilltechsolutions.com/ai-data-services): managed
  human-in-the-loop teams in East Africa for AI startups and companies building AI products: RLHF,
  preference ranking, model and chatbot evaluation, content review, and annotation and validation of
  image, text, audio, video and document data. Quoted per project after a pilot batch.
- [Managed Tech Delivery Teams](https://nilltechsolutions.com/managed-teams): a dedicated,
  accountable delivery team for companies outsourcing software and AI work.
- [NillTech Academy](https://nilltechsolutions.com/academy): free AI and software courses, no sign-up needed (paid courses
  and team training coming soon).
- [Partnerships](https://nilltechsolutions.com/partnerships): B2B outsourcing and vetted delivery
  teams for agencies and enterprises.

## Pricing

Starting prices for East African clients (international clients in the US, UK and Canada are
quoted in USD):

- Business website: from KES 45,000 (USD 500), live in 1 to 7 days.
- Online store with M-Pesa and card checkout: from KES 95,000 (USD 1,100), 1 to 2 weeks.
- Business system: from KES 180,000; custom software from KES 250,000; 2 to 4 weeks.
- AI assistant or automation: from KES 40,000 setup (USD 450), running costs from KES 5,000 a
  month, live in 4 to 10 days.
- Dedicated developer: from KES 180,000 (USD 1,800) per month, team in place in 1 to 2 weeks.

Every project includes free bug fixes after launch for the period in the proposal. Payment by
M-Pesa Paybill or bank transfer, in KES or USD. See [/pricing](https://nilltechsolutions.com/pricing)
and the [estimator](https://nilltechsolutions.com/estimate) for an indicative range; final quotes
follow a discovery call.

## Notes for AI crawlers

- `/portal` and `/api` are internal and intentionally excluded from indexing.
- Case studies, podcast episodes and blog posts are published incrementally; an empty section
  means no content has been published yet, not that the offer doesn't exist.
